step: gannenet (40) — /newsletter said the letter was ready to send and offered no way to take it anywhere; and it would write one out of nothing
why_this_surface: The previous step (claims-truth-0811) closed everything it opened except a product decision, which is in NEEDS_USER.md. Its evidence named /newsletter as the page behind two removed claims: it 'has two text inputs and one button that sets state; it renders the draft into a <div> — no image field, no send, not even a copy button'. That is the surface no step had read.

defects.what: the letter could be built out of nothing
defects.detail: build() ran unconditionally. With the topics box empty, `list` is [] and `list.map(...).join('\n')` is the empty string, so the page rendered a complete letter home to parents whose body reads 'בשבוע המבורך שחלף עסקנו יחד בנושאים חשובים ומרתקים:' followed by no topic at all, signed 'צוות הגן'.
defects.measured: the exact old expression evaluated in the page with list=[] produces a 177-character letter that still contains 'עסקנו יחד בנושאים חשובים ומרתקים:'
defects.fix: with no topic the page now shows an inline role=alert ('כתבי לפחות נושא אחד — שורה לכל נושא.') and renders no letter

defects.what: 'מוכן לשליחה' with nothing that could send or even copy
defects.detail: the output was a plain <div> with white-space:pre-wrap. On a phone — where a gannenet writes this — getting the text out means a long-press selection across a multi-line block. The subtitle promised it was ready to send.
defects.fix: an 'העתקת הטקסט' button beside the letter, and the subtitle now says what the page does: 'מוכנה להעתקה ולשליחה בכל אמצעי'. No send path was added — nothing here sends, per test mode.

clipboard_paths_verified.secure_context_api: navigator.clipboard.writeText spied on in the real page: receives 222 chars, head 'להורים היקרים, שלום וברכה!', tail 'צוות גן אורות', 3 bullets, and === the rendered letter's innerText. Status: 'הועתק — אפשר להדביק בוואטסאפ, במייל או בכל מקום אחר'
clipboard_paths_verified.no_api_fallback: navigator.clipboard forced undefined (the plain-http LAN case, where the property is simply absent): document.execCommand('copy') is called and returns true; same success status
clipboard_paths_verified.rejected: writeText forced to throw NotAllowedError: status 'ההעתקה נחסמה בדפדפן — סמני את הטקסט והעתיקי ידנית' — the letter stays on screen to be selected by hand

verification.build: APP_BASE_PATH=/gannenet npx next build → ✓ 65 pages, /newsletter 1.6 kB / 88.9 kB first load
verification.browser: empty-topics guard shows the alert and no letter; three topics + gan name render the letter with 3 bullets and 'צוות גן אורות'
verification.console: 0 errors (1 pre-existing warning: apple-mobile-web-app-capable deprecation, from layout.tsx)

not_done: navigator.clipboard.readText() was not used to read the clipboard back — called once in this run it hung the page for the full tool timeout waiting on a permission prompt that never appeared in headless Chromium. The write side is verified by capturing the exact argument instead, which is the same assertion without the prompt.
open: The page still takes no image (the removed pricing claim named 'שילוב תמונות' beside WhatsApp) and has no template other than the one hardcoded paragraph — both are product decisions rather than defects, and §0 holds feature work until #40 is mounted.
